name: Side Panel
description: Non-modal contextual detail surface that keeps related detail or editing content close to its source context. Side Panel owns the surface regions, scrolling body, anchored actions, and optional close affordance; the containing pattern owns modality, selection, dirty-state protection, request progression, responsive reflow, and navigation outcomes.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Visible detail-region label and accessible-name source. Defaults to MEMBER DETAILS and must remain non-empty.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional authored content for the structural Header slot. Product or pattern supplies identity and supporting context; Side Panel owns the region.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional authored content for the structural Body slot. Product or pattern owns data, saved/draft state, validation, feedback, and recovery.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional authored content for the structural Actions slot. Prefer public Button composition; workflow owns labels, order, pending state, and outcomes.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Controls the visible close Icon Button only. It does not define dirty-state handling, modality, or dismissal policy.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close Icon Button. Defaults to Close panel and should be localized by the consuming product when needed.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Required callback invoked by the visible close Icon Button. The containing pattern decides whether closing proceeds, is guarded, or causes navigation.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional host class for composition-level sizing or placement without inventing a Side Panel size variant.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional host style for composition-level sizing or placement, including dedicated-detail widths supplied by the containing pattern.

representations.mapsTo: publicApi.header content inside the persistent Header region
publicApi.children content inside the persistent Body region
publicApi.actions content inside the persistent Actions region

anatomy.name: surface
anatomy.description: Token-driven raised detail surface. Figma default size is 408px × 612px with a 612px minimum block size; the containing composition may provide alternate available sizing.

anatomy.name: top-bar
anatomy.description: 64px top bar containing the visible eyebrow and optional governed close Icon Button.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Structural Header slot separated from Body by a subtle divider. Authored Header content is optional, but the region remains part of Side Panel anatomy.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Structural flexible detail region with a 240px minimum that consumes remaining block space and scrolls when content exceeds the available height. Authored Body content is optional.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Structural anchored Actions slot separated by a subtle divider. Authored action content is optional; the workflow supplies action semantics and outcomes.

semantics.accessibleName: The visible non-empty eyebrow labels the detail region through aria-labelledby.
semantics.keyboardActivation: Only composed controls provide keyboard activation. The governed close Icon Button uses native button activation.
semantics.focus: Side Panel does not move, trap, or restore focus. The containing pattern owns focus movement when its interaction model requires it.
requirements: The root exposes a named non-modal region and must not expose aria-modal=true.
The visible eyebrow is non-empty and owns the region accessible name through aria-labelledby.
When showClose is true, the close Icon Button has a non-empty accessible label and invokes onClose on native activation.
When showClose is false, no close Icon Button is rendered; Side Panel does not invent an alternate dismissal mechanism.
Side Panel does not create a portal, backdrop, inert background, focus trap, Escape handler, or automatic focus restoration.
The default surface has a definite 612px block size and 612px minimum block size so long Body content scrolls instead of growing the panel and displacing Actions.
Body consumes remaining available block space, has a 240px minimum block size, and scrolls without pushing the Actions region out of the surface.
Header, Body, Actions, and both dividers remain part of the structural anatomy even when authored slot content is null, undefined, or false; only the authored content is absent.
Side Panel does not own request status, validation, dirty checks, saved/draft state, submission, selection, or responsive navigation outcomes.
The containing composition may override available sizing through className or style; Side Panel does not expose a size variant in version 1.0.0.

header.description: Optional authored Header content rendered inside the persistent Header region. Product identity and supporting context are supplied by the consuming pattern.

body.description: Optional authored Body content rendered inside the persistent flexible scrolling region. Side Panel supplies layout only.

actions.description: Optional authored action content rendered inside the persistent Actions region. Public Button composition is preferred; business progression belongs to the workflow.

events.name: onClose
events.trigger: close Icon Button native activation when showClose is true
